unitTitle: Future Simple - Be going to - Present Continuous - Conditionals Type 1 - When/If

pairsWith.noteUz: going to (reja va bashorat), will/going to farqi, Present Continuous (kelishuv) mashqlari.

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 5-UNIT MAShQLAR (26-bet, PDF 25). Yuqorida chapda ko'k '5'.

CHAP USTUN:
3) 'Nancy and John are going on different holidays this summer. Look at the table and, in pairs, ask and answer questions using the prompts given, as in the example.' JADVAL (Nancy / John): 1 travel by car - John ✓; travel by plane - Nancy ✓. 2 bring swimming costume - Nancy ✓; bring hiking boots - John ✓. 3 go with friends - Nancy ✓; go with his family - John ✓. 4 stay at a hotel - Nancy ✓; go camping - John ✓. SA: Is Nancy going to travel by car? SB: No, she isn't. She is going to travel by plane. SA: Is John going to travel by car? SB: Yes, he is.
4) 'Look at the pictures and use the verbs in the list to say what is going to happen, as in the example.' have, play, cut, eat, wash, kick. SURATLAR: 1 homilador ayol - Sara is going to have a baby. 2 bola to'pga yugurmoqda - He ...... the ball. 3 qiz fleyta bilan - Susie ...... the flute. 4 yigit ko'p idish oldida - Dave ...... the dishes. 5 (o'ng ustun) kelin-kuyov tort oldida - They ...... the cake. 6 bola oshxona stolidan pechenye olmoqchi - Bobby ...... some biscuits.

O'NG USTUN:
5) 'Fill in the gaps with 'll or the correct form of be going to, as in the example.' 1 A: The doctor won't be in tomorrow. B: I'll visit him today, then. 2 A: It's very cold in here. B: Really? I ...... close the window. 3 A: Can I watch TV? B: No, we ...... leave soon. 4 A: Look at those dark clouds! B: Oh no! It ...... rain again! 5 A: We forgot to call the repairman. B: That's okay. I ...... call him tomorrow. 6 A: Why is Mary excited? B: She ...... spend the day at the sea.
'Future Simple - Be going to - Present Continuous':
6) 'George and Irene have decided to leave the city. Look at the prompts and say what they intend to do and what they have arranged to do, as in the example.' • hire movers/March 12 → They are hiring movers on March 12. (RASM: yuk tashuvchilar) • sell their flat in the city (RASM: ko'p qavatli bino) ...... (davomi keyingi betda)

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '26'.

exercises.instructionEn: Nancy and John are going on different holidays this summer. Look at the table and, in pairs, ask and answer questions using the prompts given, as in the example. Table: 1 travel by car (John) / travel by plane (Nancy); 2 bring swimming costume (Nancy) / bring hiking boots (John); 3 go with friends (Nancy) / go with his family (John); 4 stay at a hotel (Nancy) / go camping (John).
exercises.instructionUz: Nensi va Jon bu yozda turli ta'tilga borishyapti. Jadvalga qarang va juftlikda ko'rsatmalar bilan savol-javob qiling, namunadagidek. Jadval: 1 mashinada sayohat (Jon) / samolyotda (Nensi); 2 cho'milish kiyimi olish (Nensi) / piyoda yurish botinkasi (Jon); 3 do'stlar bilan borish (Nensi) / oilasi bilan (Jon); 4 mehmonxonada turish (Nensi) / lagerga borish (Jon).
exercises.explanationUz:
GOING TO - SAVOL, QISQA JAVOB,
  TASDIQ.

  Is Nancy going to ...?
  No, she isn't. She is going to
  ... / Yes, she is.

  Har juftlikda: birinchi ko'rsatma
  bilan ikkalasidan so'rang.


⚠ 'A SWIMMING COSTUME':

  = cho'milish kiyimi.


⚠ 'HIKING BOOTS':

  = piyoda sayohat botinkasi.
exercises.exampleEn: SA: Is Nancy going to travel by car? SB: No, she isn't. She is going to travel by plane. SA: Is John going to travel by car? SB: Yes, he is.
exercises.exampleUz: A: Nensi mashinada sayohat qilmoqchimi? B: Yo'q. U samolyotda sayohat qilmoqchi. A: Jon mashinada sayohat qilmoqchimi? B: Ha.
modelAnswers: 2 A: Is Nancy going to bring a swimming costume? B: Yes, she is. A: Is John going to bring a swimming costume? B: No, he isn't. He is going to bring hiking boots.
3 A: Is Nancy going to go with friends? B: Yes, she is. A: Is John going to go with friends? B: No, he isn't. He is going to go with his family.
4 A: Is Nancy going to stay at a hotel? B: Yes, she is. A: Is John going to stay at a hotel? B: No, he isn't. He is going to go camping.
modelAnswersUz: 2 Nensi cho'milish kiyimi olmoqchimi? - Ha. Jon-chi? - Yo'q. U piyoda yurish botinkasi olmoqchi.
3 Nensi do'stlari bilan bormoqchimi? - Ha. Jon-chi? - Yo'q. U oilasi bilan bormoqchi.
4 Nensi mehmonxonada turmoqchimi? - Ha. Jon-chi? - Yo'q. U lagerga bormoqchi.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and use the verbs in the list to say what is going to happen, as in the example. Pictures: 1 Sara (pregnant woman); 2 a boy running to a ball; 3 Susie with a flute; 4 Dave in front of a pile of dishes; 5 a bride and groom with a cake; 6 Bobby reaching for biscuits.
exercises.instructionUz: Suratlarga qarang va ro'yxatdagi fe'llar bilan nima bo'lishini ayting, namunadagidek. Suratlar: 1 Sara (homilador ayol); 2 bola to'pga yugurmoqda; 3 Syuzi fleyta bilan; 4 Deyv bir uyum idish oldida; 5 kelin-kuyov tort bilan; 6 Bobbi pechenyega qo'l uzatmoqda.
exercises.explanationUz:
GOING TO - KO'RINIB TURGAN
  BAShORAT.

  1 Sara is going to HAVE a baby
    (NAMUNA)
  2 He is going to KICK the ball
  3 Susie is going to PLAY the
    flute
  4 Dave is going to WASH the
    dishes
  5 They are going to CUT the cake
  6 Bobby is going to EAT some
    biscuits


⚠ 'TO KICK':

  = tepmoq.


⚠ 'THE FLUTE':

  = fleyta (nay).

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with 'll or the correct form of be going to, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni 'll yoki be going to ning to'g'ri shakli bilan to'ldiring, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
'LL (shu zahoti qaror) yoki GOING
  TO (reja / dalil)?

  1 I'LL visit him today (qaror -
    NAMUNA)
  2 I'LL close the window (qaror)
  3 we'RE GOING TO leave soon
    (reja)
  4 It'S GOING TO rain (dalil -
    qora bulutlar)
  5 I'LL call him tomorrow (qaror)
  6 She'S GOING TO spend the day
    at the sea (reja)


⚠ 'A REPAIRMAN':

  = ta'mirlovchi usta.


⚠ 'DARK CLOUDS':

  = qora bulutlar.

sections.title: Future Simple - Be going to - Present Continuous

exercises.instructionEn: George and Irene have decided to leave the city. Look at the prompts and say what they intend to do and what they have arranged to do, as in the example. • hire movers/March 12 → They are hiring movers on March 12. • sell their flat in the city (continued on page 27)
exercises.instructionUz: Jorj va Ayrin shaharni tark etishga qaror qilishdi. Ko'rsatmalarga qarang va ular nima qilmoqchi (niyat) va nimani kelishib qo'ygan (aniq reja) ekanini ayting, namunadagidek. • hire movers/March 12 → Ular 12-martda yuk tashuvchilarni yollashyapti. • sell their flat in the city (davomi 27-betda)
exercises.explanationUz:
NIYAT yoki KELIShUV?

  SANA BOR (March 12) → KELIShUV →
    Present Continuous:
    They ARE HIRING movers on
    March 12.

  SANA YO'Q → NIYAT → going to:
    They ARE GOING TO SELL their
    flat in the city.


⚠ 'MOVERS':

  = yuk tashuvchilar (ko'chishda).


⚠ 'TO HIRE':

  = yollamoq.
exercises.exampleEn: They are hiring movers on March 12.
modelAnswers: 1 They are hiring movers on March 12.
2 They are going to sell their flat in the city.
modelAnswersUz: 1 Ular 12-martda yuk tashuvchilarni yollashyapti. (NAMUNA - sana bor → kelishuv)
2 Ular shahardagi kvartirasini sotmoqchi. (sana yo'q → niyat)

patterns.formula: Is + KIM + going to + FE'L? — Yes, ... is. / No, ... isn't. ... is going to ...
patterns.exampleEn: Is Nancy going to travel by car? — No, she isn't. She is going to travel by plane.
patterns.exampleUz: Nensi mashinada sayohat qilmoqchimi? — Yo'q. U samolyotda sayohat qilmoqchi.

patterns.formula: Look at ...! It's going to + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: Look at those dark clouds! It's going to rain again!
patterns.exampleUz: Anavi qora bulutlarga qara! Yana yomg'ir yog'adi!

patterns.formula: KIM + are + V-ing + on + SANA (kelishuv) / KIM + are going to + FE'L (niyat)
patterns.exampleEn: They are hiring movers on March 12. They are going to sell their flat.
patterns.exampleUz: Ular 12-martda yuk tashuvchilarni yollashyapti. Ular kvartirasini sotmoqchi.
patterns.explanationUz: ⚠ Sana bor - Continuous; sana yo'q - going to.
